subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw expose context-engine capabilities, status, doctor, and rotate as a core Gateway/plugin control API once the session-targeting and descriptor drift blockers are fixed?
rationale: The mechanical bugs can be fixed, but the PR creates a new public Gateway surface plus optional ContextEngine plugin contract with operator/admin control semantics that require maintainer API intent.

options.title: Approve after blockers
options.body: Keep the core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, truthful method advertisement or RPC handlers, focused tests, and docs/upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the surface
options.body: Limit the change to read-only status/doctor or HTTP-only endpoints and defer admin rotate or Gateway RPC method exposure until the contract is settled.

options.title: Defer core control
options.body: Pause or close this PR and keep context-engine maintenance on plugin/private surfaces until a broader Gateway control contract exists.

recommendation.title: Approve after blockers
recommendation.body: Keep the core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, truthful method advertisement or RPC handlers, focused tests, and docs/upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history points to steipete as the recent owner of the relevant Gateway session and descriptor policy surfaces.
